entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: Vast, mana-imbued forest in northern Aerona on Dominaria that seemed to whisper.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Region of Dominaria containing the woods.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Strongly affected by the forest in her youth; became its new maro-sorcerer.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Hometown companion of Greensleeves who moved the army into the woods.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: Village at the forest border, hometown of Gull and Greensleeves, destroyed in 4073 AR.

entities.name: Greensleeves's Grove
entities.description: Encampment of tree huts built in the woods.

entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: Called the forest's maro-sorcerer Gaea's Liege.

events.summary: Dacian and Towser destroy White Ridge in 4073 AR.
events.quote: until it was destroyed in 4073 AR by the wizards Dacian and Towser .

events.summary: A year later Gull and Greensleeves move their army into the woods and build Greensleeves's Grove.
events.quote: Gull and Greensleeves moved their army into the woods.

events.summary: In preparation for the New Phyrexian invasion, the forest manifests a new maro-sorcerer, Greensleeves.
events.quote: the forest manifested a new maro-sorcerer: Greensleeves.

relations.quote: Whispering Woods is a vast forest in North Aerona
Gull and Greensleeves moved their army into the woods.
